verdict: No self-serve console. You apply as a technology partner, and Aircall staff create your dev and production OAuth apps by hand over email. The work is small; the waiting is most of the timeline.
start_now: Apply to the partner program and write your plan doc before you write code. Nothing moves until both are approved.

cases.case: One Aircall account only (private app, API key)

cases.outcome: Partner approval, plan review, manual app creation, launch review
Only after 10 customers use the integration

steps.title: Apply to the Technology Partner Program
steps.detail: Requires a live product with a company website.

steps.title: Draft the integration plan document
steps.detail: What you're building and the main features. Aircall reviews it before creating your dev account.

steps.title: Send a fresh email and phone number for the dev account
steps.detail: The email must not belong to any existing Aircall account. Trial lasts 4 months, extendable.

steps.title: Request the development OAuth app
steps.detail: Email your redirect URIs (up to 5). Localhost is rejected: use ngrok or a staging server.

steps.title: Aircall creates the app and shares credentials
steps.detail: Took 3 days for dev in our run. Credentials arrive through a secure share link.

steps.title: Request the production OAuth app
steps.detail: Separate request with production redirect and install URIs.

steps.title: Launch review and in-product publishing
steps.detail: Submit a demo recording, help-center article, logo and screenshots. Aircall reviews them in 1–5 business days and publishes in 3–5. Publishing inside the dashboard is mandatory so admins can uninstall.

blockers.text: Plan document is a hard gate. The dev account is not created until it's approved.
Every follow-up email moves your request to the back of the queue. Wait at least 3 business days.
Status changes are silent. Our dev account was activated without notice and later suspended without a reason (fixed same day on request).

Going quiet is risky: a plan with no reply is discarded after 1 month; during the build Aircall follows up monthly for 2 months, then decommissions your assets a month later. They expect completion within 6 months and a progress update every 2 months.
Webhooks are verified with a token in the payload, not a signature header. There is no revoke endpoint.
Rate limit is 120 requests per minute per company.

agent_can: Draft the partner application and plan doc
Draft each email with the exact fields Aircall asks for
Track who owes the next reply and when to follow up
List redirect URIs that Aircall will accept
you_must: Be approved as a technology partner
Send every email from your company address
Run a public tunnel or staging server
Fill the publishing form and assets
unverified: Waiting times come from one real integration (Aug–Oct 2026) plus Aircall's stated review windows; other teams may move faster
